attacks.name: Optic Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

|!wild| |!hit| |*Speed of Sight|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Optic Blast| attack. This additional attack may not target the original target character and does not have the |*Speed of Sight| special rule.

attacks.name: Optic Devastation
steps: |!wild| |*Suppression|: After each attack is resolved, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.

superPowers.name: X-Men Blue (Affiliation: Uncanny X-Men)
superPowers.body: When an allied character deals |!damage| to an enemy character with an attack, another allied character within |!range| 5 of the attacking character may gain 1 |!power| after the attack is resolved. A character may gain only 1 |!power| as a result of this Leadership ability per Turn.

superPowers.name: Field Leader
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 4. That character Advances |!range_small|. A character can be made to Advance by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Quick Draw
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack and the attacker is not within |!range| 2 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Instead of rolling dice equal to its Defense, it rolls 5 defense dice. Then, if this character suffers no |!damage| from the attack, after the attack is resolved, the attacker suffers 2 |!damage|.

erratas.body: "Optic Blast" can now Push characters up to Size 3 instead of 2. A "Speed of Sight" special rule was added, that can trigger an additional attack.
"Optic Devastation" now triggers "Suppression" instead of "Concussive Force", which saps 1 |!power| per |!wild| instead of 1 single |!power|.
"X-Men Blue" Leadership was replaced, now allowing to generate |!power| instead of reducing |!power| costs.
The digital card for "Quick Draw" is of type Active instead of Reactive.
